name: Sofitel Cotonou Marina Hotel & Spa
desc: A few steps away from the beach, Sofitel Cotonou Marina Hotel & Spa is a unique gem of luxury, at the heart of Benin. Featuring the largest hotel convention center in the city, this newly-open 5-star hotel embraces modernity with versatile meeting spaces and well-appointed rooms & suites. For a relaxing escape, guests may also choose a villa with private pool and make the most of a holistic destination for leisure…
address: Boulevard de la Marina, Cotonou, 081 BP 7300 Cotonou Aeroport

name: Novotel Cotonou Orisha
desc: The Novotel Cotonou reopens its doors after 2 years of full renovation. Contemporary style, in a 7 ha wooded garden, the hotel has 110 rooms, including 6 suites, new generation of elegant and comfortable N'room design. For your business or leisure stays, our meeting rooms, restaurant, bar and pool welcome you in the most beautiful Benin tradition

name: ibis Cotonou
desc: The seaside ibis Cotonou Hotel is right in the business district, just 5 minutes from the airport and 10 minutes from the city center. The hotel has 101 air-conditioned bedrooms with WiFi, 3 are suitable for people with reduced mobility. With a bar, 24/7 snacks, private car park & free shuttle bus. With friends or colleagues, enjoy time in our friendly bar. The hotel shares the same restaurant as NOVOTEL.
address: 1821 Boulevard de la Marina, 08 BP 0929, COTONOU
